meta.title: Code Quality — KB Labs
meta.description: Quality gates as code. AI review, baseline regression tracking, and automated QA across the monorepo — running on the same engine you install.

pipeline.desc: ESLint across all packages in dependency order. Only changed packages re-lint.
tsc --noEmit with project references. Type errors in dependencies surface first.
LLM review of the diff. Finds logic errors, security issues, and anti-patterns.

layers.title: Lint and type-check — fast, every change.
layers.body: ESLint and TypeScript run in dependency order across all packages. Only changed packages re-run. Cache restores in ~1ms for unchanged outputs.

commands.note: Lint all packages in dependency order.
Lint only changed packages and dependents.
Check staged files only. For pre-commit hooks.

layers.title: LLM review on every diff — architecture-aware.
layers.body: The review plugin sends your diff to the configured LLM with your architecture as context. Finds logic errors, security issues, and anti-patterns that linters miss. Runs as a gated workflow step.

commands.note: Review a specific PR by number.
Show active model and prompt configuration.
List past reviews with verdict and timestamp.

layers.title: Track quality over time — catch regressions before they ship.
layers.body: The QA plugin runs recurring checks on every change and tracks results by package over time. Surfaces trend degradation — a package that was 95% passing last week and is 80% today gets flagged before it ships.

commands.note: Run QA checks on the current workspace.
Show quality trend per package over last N runs.
Export structured QA report with pass/fail history.

page.heroDescription: Three plugins cover the full cycle: pre-commit gate, code review on changeset, architectural analysis in CI. Each works standalone — or together as one pipeline.
